title: Work of the Holy Spirit
definition: The work of the Holy Spirit is His divine ministry of glorifying Christ, applying salvation, sanctifying believers, empowering service, and sustaining God's people.
summary: The Holy Spirit works in creation, revelation, salvation, holiness, worship, witness, and the life of the Church.
christFocus: Jesus sends the Spirit to glorify Him, apply His saving work, and empower His people for faithful life and mission.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The work of the Holy Spirit is broad and deeply personal. He is active in creation, revelation, conviction, regeneration, sanctification, assurance, gifting, prayer, mission, and the Church's life.

The Spirit does not draw attention away from Christ. He glorifies Christ by making His truth known, applying His redemption, forming His character in believers, and empowering His witnesses.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many believers speak of the Spirit in one narrow way, either only as power, only as comfort, or only as gifting. This doctrine matters because the Spirit's work touches the whole Christian life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Spirit to make Christ known, expose sin, strengthen obedience, deepen worship, and empower service. Depend on Him in every part of discipleship.
